Beautiful tactile miniature, charming handcrafted personality, sophisticated product-render quality. Camera nearly front-facing with slight view of top and right to reveal physical thickness. Single isolated object centered, occupies 78% of square canvas, fully visible with generous transparent margin, no words, no lettering, no frame, no background, no floor. A sculpted burnt-coral wax seal bearing a small heart holds the flap, and a dark forest-green satin ribbon loosely trails beneath. Intimate treasured handwritten letter.
